[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator controller bootstrap admission
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
Requires=systemd-timesyncd.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
After=systemd-timesyncd.service systemd-time-wait-sync.service
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-controller-install.service
After=terrascale-orchestrator-controller-install.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
Before=terrascale-orchestrator-controller.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# The controller Requires this oneshot: without RemainAfterExit each
# controller start reruns admission in a loop.
RemainAfterExit=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10s
# The credential directory is memory only: rebuild it from Vault first (TS-745).
ExecStartPre=+/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator restore-controller-material
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator bootstrap-controller --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/controller.json
# A boot's first admission can fail (the seed completion is not yet readable)
# and fail the controller's start job with it; the retry that succeeds must
# start the controller. OnSuccess= cannot: with RemainAfterExit the unit never
# goes inactive. "+" runs systemctl outside this unit's sandbox.
ExecStartPost=+/usr/bin/systemctl start --no-block terrascale-orchestrator-controller.service
# Admission failures also reach the serial console, readable before any SSH path is up.
StandardError=journal+console
TimeoutStartSec=300s
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
StateDirectory=terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
StateDirectoryMode=0755
# Initial admission drops to the service account to preflight its
# credentials in a child process, so the unit runs as root by default:
# User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make systemd drop CAP_SETUID.
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_CHOWN CAP_SETGID CAP_SETUID CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE CAP_KILL
AmbientCapabilities=
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-secrets /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator-controller /run/terrascale-orchestrator-bootstrap
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
# The read-only kernel NTP health probe uses adjtimex(2); CAP_SYS_TIME is absent.
LockPersonality=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
SystemCallArchitectures=native
ProtectProc=invisible
ProcSubset=pid

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale Orchestrator host runtime
Wants=network-online.target
Requires=terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
After=network-online.target terrascale-orchestrator-host-setup.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Availability first: the restart backoff below reaches its 5min cap after
# seven starts (about 10 minutes), so at most about 17 starts fit in any hour
# and a loop at the capped backoff never reaches this burst; the host keeps
# retrying through a controller outage of any length. The limit only fails a
# runtime that restarts faster than that backoff (for example after a manual
# reset-failed), and the host-setup timer starts a failed runtime again.
StartLimitIntervalSec=1h
StartLimitBurst=20

[Service]
# READY=1 once the host is connected to its regional cell. No WatchdogSec=:
# restarting this process stops every supervised TerraBase member.
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
TimeoutStartSec=3min
# Runs as root by default: User=root with NoNewPrivileges=yes would make
# systemd drop CAP_SETUID, which the native workload helper needs.
SupplementaryGroups=
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator host --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/host.json
# Protect the host manager without throttling the managed database when idle.
# MemoryMin/MemoryLow come from the image profile; the native runner copies
# those floors to the supervisor subgroup.
CPUSchedulingPolicy=other
Nice=-20

IOSchedulingPriority=0

Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s

KillSignal=SIGTERM
KillMode=control-group

[Unit]
Description=NetBird private management network and SSH
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target
StartLimitIntervalSec=0

[Service]
Type=simple
# Cell servers reach NetBird only through the gateway /32 on TCP 443 and UDP
# 3478, with no internet route, so ICE to operators or the routing peer can
# never succeed. Skip ICE and use the relay at once (NetBird 0.79 reads
# NB_FORCE_RELAY=true in the daemon). Lazy connections (NB_LAZY_CONN, the
# replacement for the inert --enable-lazy-connection flag) open a tunnel only
# when an operator connects. Intra-region cluster traffic uses VCN private IPs
# and never NetBird. The enrollment CLI runs with a scrubbed environment.
Environment=NB_FORCE_RELAY=true
Environment=NB_LAZY_CONN=on
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/netbird service run --config /var/lib/netbird/config.json --log-file console
Restart=always
RestartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=30s
StateDirectory=netbird
StateDirectoryMode=0700
# The daemon serves NetBird SSH. Like ssh.service it stays unconfined: login
# and su sessions need root privileges, PAM, setuid helpers and the full
# filesystem. A restart issued from a session must not kill that command.
KillMode=process
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=TerraScale self-update watchdog for terrascale-orchestrator-%i.service
# The image enables the controller and host instances; see
# docs/continuous-delivery.md. Where the role's config is absent no process
# can prove an activation of its unit, and deadlines still roll back.

[Service]
Type=oneshot
# Confirms a pending activation from the unit's fresh signed version proof,
# or rolls the current link back after the deadline and restarts the unit.
# This also covers a new release that hangs instead of crashing. The role
# config names the unit's key and, optionally, its proof file. The baked
# binary hands the check to the node's known-good release, so these
# arguments must stay valid for every release.
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/terrascale-orchestrator selfupdate watchdog --root /var/lib/terrascale-orchestrator --unit terrascale-orchestrator-%i.service --config /etc/terrascale-orchestrator/%i.json
# A hung check would stop the timer, which only fires after a run ends.
TimeoutStartSec=60s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
